content.text: Imagine your digital store is thriving, but every time you try to collect payment from your customers, you're met with a cold, unforgiving message: 'Account restricted, payment failed.' This is the harsh reality for many digital creators in Zimbabwe who rely on Stripe or PayPal. But what if there's a way to break free from this cycle of payment rejection and build a sovereign digital store that truly belongs to you? With Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can deploy a digital store on the free infrastructure you control, processing transactions in minutes, not days. Today, we'll show you how to deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal come with inherent risks, from account restrictions to currency exchange fees. But Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments offer a more resilient infrastructure that lets you collect payments directly from your customers, without relying on third-party gateways. This means you can handle payment verification, order storage, and file delivery in one seamless pipeline, all on the free infrastructure you control. With this setup, you're not just building a digital store – you're creating a sovereign commerce ecosystem that's immune to platform failures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, you'll need a few essential tools: a GitHub account, a Cloudflare account, and a basic understanding of Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. You'll also need to set up a domain name and configure your DNS settings. Don't worry if this sounds daunting – we'll walk you through the steps in a moment. The key is to have a solid foundation in place before you begin building your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

With Cloudflare Pages, you'll create a seamless pipeline that integrates payment verification, order storage, and file delivery. This involves setting up a GitHub Pages site, configuring your Cloudflare Pages settings, and integrating NOWPayments for payment processing. You'll also need to connect your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. This setup will enable you to process transactions in minutes, not days, and deliver your digital products to your customers with ease.
You own every aspect of your digital store, from payment processing to file delivery, once it's deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your pipeline is set up, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves deploying your Cloudflare Pages site, configuring your payment settings, and testing your pipeline on the mainnet. You'll also need to configure your DNS settings and set up a test transaction to ensure everything is working as expected. With this setup, you'll be ready to process your first transaction and start selling your digital products to your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet the demands of your customers. This involves optimizing your Cloudflare Pages settings, configuring your payment pipeline for high traffic, and setting up a load balancer to distribute traffic across multiple servers. You may also need to consider using a content delivery network (CDN) to reduce latency and improve performance. With this setup, you'll be able to scale your digital store to meet the demands of your growing customer base.
